_comment: P565/P581b per-hull ship-art override. Values per hull (by native ModelName or HullId string): "native", "meshy", or "catalogue:<model-id>". Unlisted hulls default to native (P566). A catalogue:<id> maps the hull to ANY model in assets/ships/catalogue.json (repaired copies preferred automatically); a Meshy/catalogue entry whose asset is missing falls back to native, logged once. Curate the good Meshy/catalogue ships here, or use the inspector's M toggle + K 'keep this choice', or N/B catalogue browser + K.
